messages.subject: On the same topic of MI in lavaan...
parts:
I am getting the following cryptic error message when using miPackage="mice".

Error in if (D < 0) D <- 0 : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


In addition, the chi-square values I get under mice and under Amelia are exactly the same, which I find a bit hard to believe.

Thanks all,

David

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: On the same topic of MI in lavaan...
parts:
That line indicates that something is wrong in the D value in calculating LMRR chi-square method. For the exact chi-square values from both packages, I would try to impute the data manually and use the runMI function to pool the results. I am not sure about the proportion of missing in your data and the missing value pattern in your data so I cannot tell whether it is weird. Could you send me the snippet of your data and the full syntax you used off the list? I would like to figure the problem out. Thank you for your feedback.

Sunthud

messages.subject: Re: On the same topic of MI in lavaan...
parts:
The equal chi square issue is odd. I just ran a test on some other data (code below) and Amelia and mice gave different fits.

Alex

library(semTools)

library(lavaan)

HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '

HSMiss <- HolzingerSwineford1939[,paste("x", 1:9, sep="")]
randomMiss <- rbinom(prod(dim(HSMiss)), 1, 0.1)
randomMiss <- matrix(as.logical(randomMiss), nrow=nrow(HSMiss))
HSMiss[randomMiss] <- NA

out <- cfa.mi(HS.model, data=HSMiss, m = 3, chi="all", miPackage = "Amelia")
inspect(out, "impute")$targetFit

out2 <- cfa.mi(HS.model, data=HSMiss, m = 3, chi="all", miPackage = "mice")
inspect(out2, "impute")$targetFit
